title: Public Rails. Private Actions.
voiceStatus: script-only; windows are planning cues, not word-aligned to a recording

scenes.headline: MORE THAN YOU INTEND.
scenes.voiceover: Public chains can reveal more than you intend.
captionLines: Public chains can reveal more than you intend.
scenes.visualMechanism: An observer scan turns three public action cards into a readable trail; use no balances, addresses or fake UI.

scenes.headline: A DIFFERENT EXECUTION LAYER.
scenes.visualMechanism: The trail becomes an intention card, then a layered cutaway; this is not a repeated privacy shutter from the old film.

scenes.headline: COMPUTE ON ENCRYPTED VALUES.
scenes.voiceover: FHE lets contracts compute on encrypted values.
captionLines: FHE lets contracts compute on encrypted values.
scenes.visualMechanism: Sealed reserve tiles move through an addition/comparison mechanism and remain sealed throughout. FHE concerns encrypted state, not a public view of note secrets.

scenes.headline: PROVE VALIDITY.
scenes.voiceover: Zero-knowledge proofs check valid actions without exposing private note details.
captionLines: Zero-knowledge proofs check valid actions without exposing private
scenes.visualMechanism: A private note chamber emits a small proof; a mechanical check validates that proof without opening the chamber. Different composition and movement from FHE.

scenes.headline: VALUE MOVES AS PRIVATE NOTES.
scenes.voiceover: Inside the pool, value moves as private notes.
captionLines: Inside the pool, value moves as private notes.
scenes.visualMechanism: Two sealed note inputs are consumed; three sealed output notes are created on a different ledger plane. These are illustrative note objects, not displayed balances or proof internals.

scenes.headline: PRIVACY HAS BOUNDARIES.
scenes.kicker: PUBLIC ENTRY / PRIVATE INTERIOR / PUBLIC EXIT
scenes.voiceover: Deposits and withdrawals still reveal public information.
captionLines: Deposits and withdrawals still reveal public information.
scenes.visualMechanism: An architectural section separates public entry/exit receipts from a private interior. Show public labels AMOUNT / TOKEN / ADDRESS at the boundary, not inside. Do not imply all senders are always hidden.

scenes.headline: PUBLIC RAILS. PRIVATE ACTIONS.
scenes.voiceover: Fluton. Public rails. Private actions. Explore the testnet.
captionLines: Fluton. Public rails. Private actions. Explore the testnet.
scenes.visualMechanism: Use the exact white wordmark and optional exact small logomark. Flat graphic resolution; no repeating the old dimensional logo-docking finale. Settle by frame 1680 and hold through 1799.
